senses.gloss:
Draupadīkalyāṇa
poem. formed by the first letter of the fourth pāda of verses from Ayodhyākāṇḍa to Yuddhakāṇḍa of a.'s Rāmāyaṇasaṅgraha (MT. 3375 (b)). by Niṭṭala Upamāka Veṅkaṭeśvara, son of Kāmāmbā an. Viśvanātha. MT. 3375 (f).

Draupadīcaritra
in prose on the story of Draupadī. MD. 12399.

Draupadīpariṇaya
nāṭaka in 5 acts. by Kṛṣṇasūri. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 38. MD. 12522-24.

Draupadīpariṇayacampū
in 6 āśvāsas. by Cakrakavi (17th Cent.). See NCC. VI. p. 280b.
Adyar II. p. 20a (end of 6th Ucch.). Adyar D. V. 888. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 38. MD. 12303. 12304. 15671. MT. 4244 (inc.). TCD. 1376. Trav. Uni. 1483. T. 263. Triv. Cur. IV. 154.
Pt.. Sahṛdayā vols. IX-X. Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam, 1917 an. later in Vāṇīvilās Skt. Ser. 17.

Draupadīprabandha
Jain. by Jinasena. Delhi III. 150.

Draupadīvastrā(pa)haraṇa
kāvya. by Govardhana Śrotriya. Ahmedabad 4864 (1). B. II. 84. 86. BORI. 308 of 1884-86. 365 of 1884-87. Dāhilakṣmī XXXV. 11. XL. 5. Peters. III. p. 394 (no. 308). Rgb. 365.

Draupadīsvayaṃvara
cited by Rāmacandra in his Nāṭyadarpaṇa p. 185. GOS. 48.

Draupadīsvayaṃvara
Jain. from Bālacarita. by Amaracandra. Peters. III. p. 405 (no. 601).

Draupadīsvayaṃvara
campūkāvya. ascribed to Melpputtūr Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. BISM. 177/22. GD. 1783. 2084C. Granthappura p. 86. no. 1783. Harihara Sastri XIV. 3. Oppert I. 6002. TCD. 1488 (fr. a. the end of a ms.). Tra. Ad. Rep. 1110. 44 (D. Pariṇayacampū). Trav. Uni. L. 775D (campūkāvya). Trippūṇittura II. 191.

Draupadīsvayaṃvara
from Ādiparvan of Mahābhārata. IO. 3287.

Draupadīsvayaṃvara
nāṭaka in 2 acts exemplifying vīra an. adbhuta rasas. written a. Aṇahillapāṭakam. by Vijayapāla, son of Siddhapāla. a. the instance of the Cālukya King Bhīmadeva II (C. 1200 A. D.) Dāhilakṣmī XIII. 61.
See E. Hultzsch, ZDMG. 75 (1921) 67-68.
Ed. Muni Jinavijayaji, Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1918.

Draupadīharaṇa
a.. TCD. 1397D. Trav. Uni. C. 2344D (inc.) (Campūkāvya).
